items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin steady around $80,000 as markets rally after Democratic sweep
items.summary: Ether jumped 4% and crypto ETFs drew fresh money after Wall Street turned higher and Brent crude fell nearly 9%.

items.title: Bitcoin holds above $80,000 as Zcash jumps 12% in post-election crypto rebound
items.summary: Ether rose 8% as falling oil prices and a weaker dollar helped markets recover, even as traders weighed a tougher path for U.S.

items.title: THORChain's RUNE jumps 10% as North Korean hackers resume laundering Binance loot
items.summary: North Korea’s TraderTraitor is routing Binance hack proceeds through THORChain, swapping ether for bitcoin after an earlier wave of conversions from Tron.

items.title: RUNE sobe 15% enquanto a THORChain retoma a maioria dos swaps após a suspensão
items.summary: A THORChain restaurou as negociações de Bitcoin, Ethereum e várias outras redes após um erro de reembolso, enquanto três redes continuam pausadas.

items.title: ETFs de Ether perdem força antes de teste do suporte em US$ 2.540
items.summary: Ethereum acumula alta de 7,90% em sete dias, mas vê entradas em ETFs desacelerarem e precisa defender suporte entre US$ 2.530 e US$ 2.540.
